title: A2A Protocol Core Fields
description: Core field definitions for the A2A protocol system

ContextBlock.description: The Context Block is a core data structure used throughout the A2A protocol to pass contextual information between client and server

session_id.description: Client session identifiers (confidential, client-only, must not appear in HTTP payloads)

new_task.description: Array of task descriptions from client for processing

architectural_features.description: List of architectural features detected in the project

continue.description: Flag indicating whether to continue with the current task processing

tasks.description: Array of task objects to be processed

request_files.description: List of file paths that the client should provide in the next request

errors.description: Array of protocol errors encountered during processing

llmModel.description: LLM model id for AI Hub proxy (e.g. 'glm-4.7-flash', 'qwen3:8b')

grayRoomLlmModel.description: Optional override for gray-room sub-calls only

execution.description: Execution state for actions (new protocol format)

Task.description: The Task object represents a unit of work to be processed in the A2A protocol system

type.description: The type of operation to be performed

target.description: Target identifier for the task (e.g., file path, function name, component identifier)

FileBlock.description: The FileBlock object represents a file with its content and optional line range information

path.description: File path (absolute or relative to project root)

startLine.description: Starting line number (1-indexed) if representing a portion of the file

endLine.description: Ending line number (1-indexed, inclusive) if representing a portion of the file

ProtocolError.description: The ProtocolError object represents an error encountered during protocol processing

code.description: Error code identifier for categorizing the error

message.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong

file.description: File path where the error occurred (if applicable)

line.description: Line number where the error occurred (if applicable)
